card.name: The word daily in dosing
card.fires_on: The word "daily" (or "Daily") in dosing directions, usually right after "twice", a drug name or "mg". It also fires on "daily" inside a web address.

modes.label: Daily after twice
modes.description: "daily" completing the frequency phrase "orally twice daily".
modes.example: orally twice<< daily>> Reduced Dose 160 mg

modes.label: Daily after drug or dose
modes.description: "daily" directly after a drug name, a dose in mg, or "taken".
modes.example: mg<< daily>>; daily dosage may be raised in increments

modes.label: Daily in a URL
modes.description: "daily" as part of a news website address.
